title: CultureVLM: Characterizing and Improving Cultural Understanding of Vision-Language Models for over 100 Countries

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on the CultureVerse benchmark, which uses multiple-choice questions across three tasks (image recognition, cultural knowledge, and scene reasoning) representing 188 countries and 5 continents to measure accuracy disparities and identify Western-centric performance gaps.
